name: smwsprites-sprite-shooters
title: Sprite Shooters
description:
This shooter spawns a sprite of your choosing every so often. You can choose the sprite (custom or vanilla), the amount of it which spawns, the delay between spawns, the offsets, and the randomness of the velocity.

The default shooters spawn coins with a random velocity, to make them look like they're coming out of a pipe, like what you can do in Super Mario Maker.

To configure shooters, open up SpriteShooter.asm and scroll to SPRITE TABLES. The extension byte controls which shooter gets used.

Also includes a custom moving coin, which doesn't overwrite its velocity, and has ground friction. It should be inserted as sprite 07 to use the defaults, but it can be changed to whatever you want. Moving coin disassembly by Thomas.

This is my first sprite, so credit would be appreciated.
